name: Repair: Lamarckian
lesson: Lamarckian repair takes the worst value-per-weight items out of an overweight bag and writes that back into the chromosome, so no chromosome ever stays overweight.
lookFor: The ✂ marks show the genes that repair rewrote to 0. With this seed the optimum 123 is found in generation 25, and in generation 10 none of the 8 chromosomes has more genes set than fit. The Baldwinian preset, with the same seed and settings, finds it in generation 5. Over seeds 1 to 100, Lamarckian repair finds 123 within 100 generations in 96 runs (median generation 15) and Baldwinian repair in all 100 (median 11).
